rca of the issue: RCA: /api/scraper/apis validation uses a permissive path regex that accepts '__proto__' as a valid identifier in structured JSON mappings. Repro: PATCH scraper settings with structured_json provider and field_mappings.title='product[0].__proto__' returns 200. Expected: 400 for unsafe path. Mitigation: explicitly deny reserved dangerous segments (e.g., __proto__, prototype, constructor) during mapping validation before save.
